entry.title: New: Bill 80, CD1 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE GRANTING CAROLEE HIGASHINO A CONDITIONAL PERMIT TO CONDUCT SMALL SCALE SPECIAL EVENTS WITHIN THE COUNTY R-3 RESIDENTIAL DISTRICT, TAX MAP KEY NUMBER (2) 2-1-006:011, MAKENA, MAUI, HAWAII" The purpose of this bill is to allow the operation of small-scale commercial weddings and special events by Carolee Higashino, the owner and operator of A White Orchid Wedding.
